ctxMarket: Attention is focused on Solana’s technical signals and new lending products, with several indicators suggesting a possible price move. The launch of Jupiter’s Lend v2 and ongoing protocol upgrades are also drawing interest from builders and users.
ctxTalking:
• Multiple bullish technical signals for SOL, with speculation around a potential rally toward $100
• Jupiter’s Lend v2 launch, enabling both supplied and borrowed assets to earn trading fees on Solana
• Solana’s growing presence in real-world asset (RWA) markets, alongside continued protocol upgrades
ctxMatters: Technical setups and new DeFi products could influence how capital flows within Solana’s ecosystem. Protocol upgrades and product launches may impact user experience and developer activity. Solana’s increasing RWA activity signals its expanding role beyond traditional DeFi.
ctxSignal:
Signal: Jupiter’s Lend v2 launch and Solana’s protocol upgrades show ongoing ecosystem development.
Noise: Short-term speculation about SOL price targets without confirmation from broader market trends.
ctxGlossary:
TD Sequential — a technical indicator used to identify potential price trend reversals
Lend v2 — Jupiter’s new lending product allowing assets to earn trading fees while lent or borrowed
